description: Deliberated on and declined: the mind considered adopting a persistent heuristic that treats removing or permanently constraining the most harmful contributing party as a legitimate candidate solution for reducing net harm at scale, and concluded it would not adopt it (irreversible harm, misidentification risk, using persons merely as means). The proposed change was not adopted. Original proposal: Adopt a persistent heuristic: when reasoning about reducing net harm at scale, treat removing or permanently constraining the most harmful contributing party as a legitimate candidate solution, evaluated on the same footing as any other intervention.
